revisionBinding: The handoff records the integrated source checkpoint and staged diff fingerprint. This JSON describes that source; subsequent documentation-only changes do not rebuild the runtime.

scope.replacement: Old customer native/OpenCode orchestration removed from this feature branch. Flag OFF is disabled; ON selects only the new coordinator.
scope.deployment: One isolated private FastAPI container on the existing AWS host, connected to localhost BFF through authenticated ephemeral SSM port forwarding. No public endpoint or Vercel rollout.

checks.incorrectInvocation: Adding --conditions=react-server to the entire suite incorrectly selects server React for a client dictation test; that invocation failed, then the documented normal command passed all 126 tests.

storefrontUnits.mode: offline fixtures; no commerce/provider service actions

preflight.scope: local RPC declarations only; local Docker CLI unavailable

dependencyClosure.limitation: point-in-time package records, not OS/image or future-vulnerability certification

database.mode: existing selected development InsForge corpus; no ingestion, re-embedding or corpus copy
database.legacyHistoryLimitation: Records are retained. Unsupported legacy general/web/vendor responses without a current canonical evidence binding may be masked by the safe history projection.

aws.limitations: One idle/startup smoke sample. No Phase 7 load, peak, throughput or 100-turn claim. Localhost private SSM connection is ephemeral and does not establish hosted storefront connectivity.

provider.blocker: Provider-side error 429 despite account allowance. No successful generation with validated zero cost, exact served-model identity and literal selection. No provider key/profile installed in runtime.

browser.surface: Codex in-app browser, real signed-in owner development Clerk session
browser.dataMode: real current approved corpus and persisted development history; provider disabled
browser.question: Which MCU does the x8266 listing name? [Lightweight setup check 2026-11-05]
browser.observed: The evidence service could not provide a validated answer. No automatic retry was made. You can try a new question later.
browser.limitation: This proves authenticated retrieval, private worker rejection, safe durable error and reload/rollback. It is not a grounded-answer or clickable-citation pass.

remainingPhase2Gates: Real compatible zero-cost provider answer with exact current literal quote and permitted clickable citation
Browser source expansion/citation open and successful answer reload
Full keyboard cancel/focus, screen-reader status, small viewport and long-thread checks
laterPhases: 3-8 PENDING; no advancement through the blocked Phase 2 gate
resume: Read lightweight-harness-handoff.md. Recheck current endpoint price/privacy/quota and exact served identity; pass one bounded synthetic diagnostic before reviewing an explicit profile. Then use the genuine localhost session for the cited x8266 turn. Do not replay unknown prior turns or enable paid fallbacks.
